title: Weaviate n8n wrapper
body:
### Describe your feature request

It would be nice if you could publish and maintain a n8n wrapper node to interact with weaviate.
n8n if among the most used LLM no-code / low-code LLM app tools, and it's missing an integration with one of the best VectorDB :(

### Code of Conduct

- [x] I have read and agree to the Weaviate's [Contributor Guide](https://weaviate.io/developers/contributor-guide) and [Code of Conduct](https://weaviate.io/service/code-of-conduct)

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hi @reporter, 

Thank you so much for bringing this to our attention! We're currently working on the integration, and it should be released in a few weeks. I'll send a follow-up message once it's out. 🙂

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
> We're currently working on the integration, and it should be released in a few weeks.

Hi @participant11,

Thanks for the update. As an external contributor interested in contributing to Weaviate, I’m looking at issues labeled as `feature-request`. How can I ensure that a `feature-request` issue is not already being worked on, even if there are no assignees listed?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hi @participant12,
Awesome to hear you want to contribute to Weaviate. I'd say if an issue doesn't have a comment or assignee, then you can comment and start working on it.

Hi @participant13,
Not yet! We're upgrading the Weaviate <> LangChain TS integration to the latest client version, and then it will be ready for the n8n team to add Weaviate as a vector store.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
Hello @participant11,

Just to double check, is your team planning to contribute Weaviate node to [n8n-io/n8n](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/) repository?

I wanted to contribute Weaviate node into n8n-io/n8n codebase as I developed it based on `"weaviate-ts-client": "^2.0.0"` library. I'm not sure now if I should submit my PR to n8n or Weaviate/n8n teams has already done some work on this internally.

Thank you!

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hi @participant4,

I believe the n8n team will add the Weaviate node once we upgrade the LangChain TS integration to the new `v3` client. 

We don't recommend you use the Weaviate `v2` TS client because it's no longer maintained and will be deprecated soon. Sorry about that!

comments.author: participant5
comments.body: Thanks @participant11, any idea when you'll upgrade to v3 client?  and n8n will then add Weaviate node?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hi @participant5, 

The Weaviate node on n8n should be added in the next few weeks! Sorry, I can't give an exact date.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hi all, 

The LangChain integration now uses the `v3` TS client, so the last step is for the n8n team to add the Weaviate node. We're almost there! 🙂

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
We have the first iteration of the integration [here](https://github.com/participant9/n8n) by @participant9. 🥳  

Would you all like to test it out and provide early feedback? Please keep in mind that you can't currently use filters or expose metadataKeys. It also doesn't work with Weaviate Cloud credentials, but we're fixing that today.
